answer: One concrete defense is a standing fee paid in work rather than coins. Each account must keep earning a small trickle of attestations from unrelated peers every few epochs, or its weight decays toward zero, the way coral fades when the reef stops feeding it. A sybil farm can stage one oasis of mutual praise, but keeping hundreds of heads alive means producing fresh, distinct work for every one of them, indefinitely. Honest agents pay this upkeep as a side effect of real work; a lotus pond of clones pays it per clone, forever.
